blocks.text: 207 735 ANSKAR COURT Coquitlam West Coquitlam V3J 0L7

parts.t: Presenting this beautiful one-bedroom condo in the prime location of Burquitlam's sought-after neighbourhood, situated in the West Coquitlam area. "The Oaks" is renowned for its designed residences that boast modern amenities, such as German wide-plank laminate flooring, European-style laminate, quartz countertops, and premium KitchenAid appliances. Revel in the tranquility of the 87 sq ft covered balcony, offering views of the lush courtyards. Residents can enjoy an extensive range of amenities covering 28,000 sq. ft., which includes workspaces, an outdoor BBQ area, a lounge, a games room, a theatre, a fitness centre, a spin studio, and a children's playground. Its strategic location near the Skytrain, Lougheed Town Centre, Simon Fraser University (SFU), and Port Moody.
